purpose: Test whether structured B retains control and improves common development predictions relative to online A+.

before_models_arrive: Preserve the completed historical 4090 metadata audit; model binaries remain on 4090
Preserve completed backend screen and inspect failed cal block; do not rerun the same full check or remove the failed block
after_models_arrive: Verify four new model packages, complete budgets and same-seed initial actor/critic hashes
Evaluate each final EMA policy twice on the common identified reference plant
Compare common development forward/response errors with the zero-response baseline

training_requirements.paired_initial_actor_and_critic: Required identical tensor hashes within each seed; isolate random streams before model construction and record collection/replay RNG settings
training_requirements.shared_settings: Motion inventory, parameter manifest, action interface, reward, termination rules, randomization distribution, precision, learning rates and update budgets
training_requirements.online_labels: Policies collect different transitions; do not claim identical training labels

evaluation_requirements.primary_evaluation: First evaluation; second is a repeatability check, not another training seed
evaluation_requirements.intermediate_checkpoints: Preserve 250/500 checkpoints for triggered diagnosis, never replace final with best intermediate
evaluation_requirements.save_trajectories: First final evaluation of each B model
prediction_metrics: Common fit/cal forward joint-angle errors at 8/32 steps
Common scaled response errors at 4/8 steps versus A+ and zero response

proposed_development_gates_to_freeze_bef.aggregation: Conservative repeat extrema within each seed; require both seeds and all budget/input checks
proposed_development_gates_to_freeze_bef.meaning: Readiness to investigate C, not evidence of superiority, equivalence or significance

required_controls: Same recorded initial physical state, commands, parameters, step sizes and stored perturbation directions
Unperturbed trajectory and separate plus/minus trajectories
Within-backend repeatability, cross-backend forward differences and central-difference responses
response_backend_validation.tolerance: Prespecify and justify against numerical repeatability and response scale before inspection; never tune solely to pass

stop_rules: Failed A+ control, incomplete budget or invalid input/weights stops that machine before B
Failed B control triggers diagnosis using saved checkpoints and trajectories, not automatic budget extension or relaxed termination
Do not start C until B control and response-data validity are established and a hybrid objective is implemented
D/C-perm remain pending validated response calibration and a justified window tolerance

launch_readiness.paired_initialization_implementation_and: isolated module RNG + initial tensor reference check; unit and bounded GPU validation
